Message.MsgText: Invalid ENTRY type: Entry Type.

Explanation.p: The Connector was configured to use an Entry Type that is not supported.

OperatorResponse.p: Reconfigure the Connector to use a valid Entry Type.

Message.MsgText: Missing ENTRY type. Entry type is null.

Explanation.p: The Connector was configured to use no Entry Type.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the Entry Type in the Connector.

Message.MsgText: Invalid ISAM configuration file: file name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was configured to use an invalid ISAM Configuration File.

OperatorResponse.p: Reconfigure the Connector to use a valid ISAM Configuration File.

Message.MsgText: Could not log on to ISAM.

Explanation.p: The Connector was configured to use invalid ISAM credentials.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the ISAM ID and ISAM Password configuration parameters of the Connector are set to valid values.

Message.MsgText: Could not query ISAM Domains.

Explanation.p: The Connector was unable to query ISAM for a list of valid Domains.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure you have configured the ISAM JRTE correctly, and that all Configuration parameters are correct. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Could not shutdown ISAM object name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was unable to shutdown ISAM.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure you have configured the ISAM JRTE correctly, and that all Configuration parameters are correct. Ensure your ISAM Server is operational and available. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Could not retrieve entries for: object name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was unable to retrieve entries for the target object.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the Connector to is configured to use the correct Entry Type. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Could not retrieve next entry for: object name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was unable to retrieve the next entry for the target object.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the Connector to is configured to use the correct Entry Type. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Could not find entries for: object name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was unable to find entries for the target object.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the Connector to is configured to use the correct Entry Type. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: There was an error while creating: object name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was unable to create an entry of the configured Entry Type.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the HashMap object returned from the TAMConnectorException.getFailed method for more details on the error. Ensure the Connector is configured to use the correct Entry Type. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: There was an error while updating: entry name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was unable to modify an entry of the configured Entry Type.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the HashMap object returned from the TAMConnectorException.getFailed method for more details on the error. Ensure the Connector is configured to use the correct Entry Type. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Could not delete entry for: entry name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was unable to delete an entry of the configured Entry Type.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the Connector is configured to use the correct Entry Type. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Unable to interface with the ISAM server. The following invalid message was retrieved by ISAM while processing an exception thrown by ISAM: invalid message.

Explanation.p: The Connector has received an exception while interfacing with ISAM. The message type attached to the exception message is invalid message.

OperatorResponse.p: See the logs for additional information on how to respond. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Unable to interface with the ISAM server. The following error message was retrieved by ISAM while processing an exception thrown by ISAM: error message.

Explanation.p: The Connector has tapped a ISAM exception while interfacing with ISAM. The message type attached to the exception message is error message.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the Connector to is configured correctly, and that the ISAM Server is operational. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Unable to interface with the ISAM server. While retrieving the cause of an exception thrown by ISAM, an internal exception has occured.

Explanation.p: The Connector has trapped an underlying Java Exception while attempting to find the cause for a previous ISAM exception.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the logs for details. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Unable to complete the operation. The attribute attribute name was missing.

Explanation.p: The Connector was attempting an operation for a specific Entry Type and was missing an attribute.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the required attribute for the respective Entry Type is available. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Connector search failed. An unsupported search criteria was specified.

Explanation.p: The Connector was attempting to search/find with unsupported search criteria.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify the search criteria for the respective Entry Type is valid.

Message.MsgText: Deleting policy failed. User name is not specified.

Explanation.p: The Connector was attempting to delete a Policy without a valid User Name.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the User Name is valid for the Policy being deleted. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Invalid Resource Type: resource type.

Explanation.p: The Connector was attempting an operation with an invalid resource type.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the resource type is valid for the Entry Type. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Admin Group group name is reserved and cannot be deleted.

Explanation.p: The Connector was attempting to delete a Group that is reserved.

OperatorResponse.p: Unreserve the Group before attempting to delete it.

Message.MsgText: Admin User user name is reserved and cannot be deleted.

Explanation.p: The Connector was attempting to delete a User that is reserved.

OperatorResponse.p: Unreserve the User before attempting to delete it.

Message.MsgText: Error while loading the group group name.

Explanation.p: The Connector could not load the Group specified.

OperatorResponse.p: Confirm the Group exists in ISAM. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: No Credentials Exist for User: user name.

Explanation.p: The Connector could not find credentials for the User specified.

OperatorResponse.p: Confirm the User credentials exist in ISAM.

Message.MsgText: Operation Code operation code not supported.

Explanation.p: The Connector does not support the operation code specified.

OperatorResponse.p: Change to a supported operation code.

No valid value found for the following Connector Configuration Parameter: Config Param Name.

Explanation.p: The Connector was configured with a Configuation Parameter that either had no value, or the value specified was invalid.

OperatorResponse.p: Reconfigure the Connector to use valid values for all required Configuration Parameters.

Message.MsgText: Unable to interface with the ISAM server. The following invalid context message was retrieved by ISAM while processing an exception thrown by ISAM: invalid context message.

Explanation.p: The Connector has tapped a ISAM exception while interfacing with ISAM. The message type attached to the exception message is invalid context.

OperatorResponse.p: See the logs for additional information on how to respond. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: Unable to interface with the ISAM server. The following unknown message type was retrieved by ISAM while processing an exception thrown by ISAM: unknown message.

Explanation.p: The Connector has tapped a ISAM exception while interfacing with ISAM. The message type attached to the exception message is unknown.

OperatorResponse.p: See the logs for additional information on how to respond. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact IBM support.
